event.title: ProjectX was accepted into Y Combinator
event.summary: ProjectX reported @BishalK_ @runallapps and me survived on $900 for 2 weeks, before: - we went viral with more than 2M views - we got into YC - we had thousands of users I still couldn't imagine what would have happened if things went otherwise.
